apps.versionDescription:
This is gonna be the last release before the multi-spec-support branch takes over I think. When that happens, Misskey and other fediverse platforms will be usable with this app. This release uses more tried-and-tested code though.

# v2.1.4.8 Release Notes

## New Features

- **Copy text from image**: Tap "Copy text from image" in the media description editor to automatically extract text from images using VisionKit OCR.
- **Always Gallery Mode for Lists**: Toggle "Always Gallery Mode" in the List editor to persistently view that list in Gallery Mode.

## Bug Fixes

- I think we fixed the bug where scroll position wasn't retained when opening updated timelines and switching to the ol' GM.
- Gallery Mode now correctly applies the "Hide Seen Posts" filter instead of bypassing it with legacy code.
- Long-pressing gallery thumbnails no longer visually selects the entire grid.
- Gallery Mode applies to all profile tabs again.
- Tag groups that vanished from your saved timeline filters are now recovered from AppStorage if SwiftData loses them.
- The warning for hidden posts now correctly displays across a single line.
- Tapping tags on IceShrimp servers now loads a search view instead of hitting their broken tag API endpoint.
- "Open in Browser" in posts and profiles now respects your `preferredBrowser` setting, instead of forcing Safari.

## Known Issues

- Gallery Mode layout bugs may still occur in edge cases.
- Remote Media Fallbacks are still broken, so videos aren't loading under IceShrimp.Net still.
- The **Inter (Bluesky)** font file is broken in this build. Easy fix, just download the file yourself and select it with the font picker.

sorry this post kinda sucks, im tired.
apps.localizedDescription:
IceCubesApp is an open-source application for accessing the decentralized social network Mastodon! It's built entirely in SwiftUI, making it fast, lightweight, and easy to use.

Community Edition takes this app to the next-level, implementing feature requests & bug fixes as suggested by the community.
